== Background ==

The Orc Language is written in three books near the [[Bear Room Quest]].

If you learn to speak ''Orcish'' while on [[Rookgaard]] you can trade with [[Blind Orc]], who lives on a hill over the main [[Free Account]] dungeon north of [[town]] ({{Mapper Coords|125.96|125.129|7|3|text=here}}), and buy [[equipment]] you can't usually get in common [[Rookgaard]] stores.

Learning ''Orcish'' is the only way to get a [[Bow]] on [[Rookgaard]] but buying one seem to be a waste unless you're planning to stay there.

[[Amber]] speaks some orcish words. Ask her about Orc Language. She will tell you more about it if you give her some [[salmon]].

After human race did spread around Tibia, and [[Minotaurs]] found out of [[Mintwallin]] and built settlements to [[Rookgaard]] and different parts of Tibia, many of [[Orcs]] have forgot their native language, and instead communicate with uttering and basic human language.

Only elite officers of the Orcish race, [[Orc Leader]]s and [[Orc Warlord]]s who live in [[Ulderek's Rock]], the oldest city of Orcs, and some hermits, such as [[Blind Orc]] seem to speak Orcish fluently.

== Vocabulary ==

=== General ===
* Charach - Hi
* Futchi - Bye
* Mok - Yes
* Burp - No
* Ikem goshak - Offer
* Goshak - Buy
* Porak - [[Weapon]]
* Bata - [[Armor]] or [[Helmet]]
* Dora - [[Shields|shield]]

=== Weapons ===
* Burka Bata - [[Sword]]
* Charcha - [[Sabre]]
* Hakhak - [[Hatchet]]
* Burka - [[Short Sword]]
* Batuk - [[Bow]]

=== Common phrases (probable translations) ===
* Buta humak - Damn/Stupid humans
* Fetchi maruk buta! - Fade you stupid!
* Ikem rambo zambo! - Respective farewell (exact meaning is unknown)
* KRAK ORRRRRRK! - FOR THE ORCS!
* Maruk goshak ta? - Do you want to buy it?
* Maruk goshak tefar pixo ul batuk? - Do you want to buy arrows for a bow?
* Maruk nixda! - You can't afford!
* Orc buta bana! - Orcs shall rise! ''or'' Orc won't forget!
* Ranat Ulderek! - Worship Ulderek!
* Ulderek futgyr humak! - Ulderek, smite the humans!

== Numbers ==

[[Orcs]] do not seem to have any words for numbers; according to Orcish writings, they seem to use numbers of [[Human]]s, but way they pronounce them is unknown.

The only numbers they seem to know are 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5. If one wants to write number over 5, it is shown as [[Wikipedia:Addition|addition]], for example number 11 is shown as "5 5 1".

However, if you say Goshak Tefar Pixo to the blind orc, he will sell you 10 arrows.
